title: Gen-CT
fill_note: DENSE layered wind with a jig; scorer cap 0.65
fill_how: The scored turns assume a dense, layer-by-layer wind at fill 0.65 (insulated-wire area / window; the scorer cap). Use a winding jig on a drill/lathe with a turn counter, lay each layer side-by-side with light back-tension, and do not scramble-wind: a scramble wind only reaches ≈0.55–0.60 and then the window holds fewer turns (scorer what-if `--fill 0.60` is in the table above). Never wind more than the listed turns — the copper must stay below the flanges.
steel_extra: **New steel:** Ø201 discs, M3 clamp map R30 at 0/90/180/270° and R44 on the inter-pole angles 67.5/112.5/247.5/292.5° (both inside the R76 magnet ring). Cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf`; no earlier disc fits.
o5_note: 48 DIAMETRIC Ø5×5 fitted, 3 per inter-pole gap (R77.6/83.8/90), Halbach-oriented (rule engraved on every arc)
card_title: Gen-CT · 8p/12c · INVERTED keyhole pole on 24 AWG (Ø20 inside, N42 crossbar OUTSIDE)
card_sub: Ø20 N52 @R76 + N42 20×10×5 @R91.6 (20 mm tangential, outside) keyhole · 48 diametric Ø5 · 24 AWG bobbins r58–105.5 × 6.8 mm · 2× Ø201 steel · 2026-10-20
idea: The other top pole family (Gen-CM, 2026-10-18) re-built for 24 AWG: the Ø20 N52 disc sits INSIDE at R76 and the N42 block goes OUTSIDE it with its 20 mm side TANGENTIAL, so each pole is widest at the outer radius where the sector coils are widest. Disc and block share one keyhole pocket (0.6 mm apart). The 24 AWG stator uses 6.8 mm tall copper × 16.5 mm build on r58–105.5 bobbins (one ≈390 m spool). Different rotors from Gen-CS/CU (smaller pole radius, Ø201 steel), and the very same wound 24 AWG stator as Gen-CS — a rotor swap.
steel_note: Steel: 2× Ø201 × 4.76 mm (3/16") mild-steel discs, clamp map hub M3 at R22 0/90/180/270°, 4× Ø4.3 brace holes R18 at 45/135/225/315°, 16 arc-clamp M3 at R76 ±13° from every pole, index notch at +X — cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf` (laser-cut service). Lobed arcs: 2.4 mm PLA around each pocket; the epoxy-to-steel bond, not the PLA, holds the magnets. New discs (Ø201, clamp ring at the pole radius).
retro_md:
## Modular notes (Gen-CT)

Frame (R109.5 rods), Ø229 stator OD, bearing bridges, shaft and collars as Gen-CS/CP. New: Ø201 steel discs and 16 inverted-pole arcs (disc R76, block outside). **Its stator, bobbins, 306-turn 24 AWG winding and gap sleeve are exactly Gen-CS's** (scan s5: the same r58–105.5 × 6.8 × 16.5 mm window is the optimum for both pole shapes), so Gen-CS ↔ Gen-CT is a ROTOR swap on one wound stator. Swap stators with the 4 temporary M4 jack rods: raise rotor B on the nuts (clap hazard in reverse, never by hand), swap stator + gap sleeve, lower rotor B, remove the rods.
